name: Apple
about: Apple makes the iPhone, the Mac and the iPad. It also sells services like app downloads and music.

name: Microsoft
about: Microsoft makes Windows and Office. It also runs a cloud service, where people and businesses pay to use its computers over the internet.

name: NVIDIA
about: NVIDIA designs computer chips. People use them for video games and to build AI.

name: Costco
about: Costco runs warehouse stores and websites. Shoppers pay a yearly fee to be members.

name: Nike
about: Nike designs and sells sports shoes, clothes and gear. Other companies make most of it.

name: Amazon
about: Amazon runs stores online and in person. It also rents out its computers over the internet.

name: Tesla
about: Tesla makes electric cars. It also makes batteries that store power for homes and businesses.

name: Bitcoin
about: Bitcoin is a digital currency. No company or bank runs it.

name: Ethereum
about: Ethereum is a computer network. It has its own digital currency, called ether. People also run programs on it.

name: Solana
about: Solana is a computer network. It has its own digital currency, called SOL. People also run programs on it.
